name: What should I prioritize first during a bathroom upgrade?

mainEntity.name: What should I prioritize first during a bathroom upgrade?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prioritize fixing underlying moisture damage, upgrading the exhaust ventilation system, and installing reliable waterproofing behind shower tile. A bathroom must handle high humidity daily, so skipping proper water management will ruin even the most expensive tile or cabinetry over time. Next, focus on functional task lighting around the vanity and choosing durable, non-porous surfaces like quartz countertops and porcelain floor tiles. High-traffic elements such as pressure-balanced shower valves, quality shutoff valves, and comfort-height toilets provide long-term reliability and are difficult to replace once construction closes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prioritize proper waterproofing, adequate exhaust ventilation, and fixing hidden moisture issues first, followed by reliable plumbing valves and durable non-porous surfaces.
